simulationAssumptions.applicableConditions: Conventional operator_with_tools profile nominal 4-layer path duration context
simulationAssumptions.justification: Illustrative presentation range anchored near historical 84-98 minute mean breakout figures, extended to 270 minutes to span multi-stage lateral and data-access progression.
simulationAssumptions.reviewNote: Presentation context only; must not directly force control success or failure without causal prerequisite and response checks.

simulationAssumptions.applicableConditions: Agentic orchestration profile nominal 4-layer path duration context
simulationAssumptions.justification: Illustrative presentation band between the 15-minute fast case and 4-hour typical deep-access observation reported by GTIG.
simulationAssumptions.reviewNote: Presentation context only; does not imply universal agentic speed or guaranteed SOC evasion.

simulationAssumptions.applicableConditions: Allocation of nominal path duration across layers 1..3
simulationAssumptions.justification: Public reporting does not disaggregate total intrusion time into per-layer intervals; weights are synthetic scenario allocations.

simulationAssumptions.applicableConditions: Additional external ingress attempts after the initial foothold attempt
simulationAssumptions.justification: Equal 5-minute scenario cost applied identically to all attacker profiles when probing secondary external entry points.
simulationAssumptions.reviewNote: Applied identically across conventional and agentic profiles.

simulationAssumptions.applicableConditions: Local registry startup persistence action (T1547.001) on executed Windows hosts
simulationAssumptions.justification: Synthetic scheduling duration for post-exploitation persistence step.
simulationAssumptions.reviewNote: Requires established app_exec and persist_user permission.

simulationAssumptions.applicableConditions: Local file encryption action (T1486) on executed Windows hosts
simulationAssumptions.justification: Synthetic scheduling duration for local endpoint encryption step.
simulationAssumptions.reviewNote: Requires established app_exec and write_local_files permission.

simulationAssumptions.applicableConditions: Bulk data export following a confirmed sensitive dataset read
simulationAssumptions.justification: Synthetic 120-second setup plus size-proportional transfer duration (or 120 seconds when dataset size is unknown).
simulationAssumptions.reviewNote: Requires prior data_read, controlled collection host, and boolean egress permission.

simulationAssumptions.applicableConditions: Probability that a public SSL-VPN/GlobalProtect web portal is routed behind an inline WAF enforcement point in exploratory estates
simulationAssumptions.justification: Models partial inline WAF coverage across edge portals so virtual patching is neither universally present nor absent.
simulationAssumptions.reviewNote: Bounded in [0, 1]; held constant across attacker comparisons on the same estate.

simulationAssumptions.applicableConditions: Per-action baseline behavioral detection probability on monitored layers when a modeled ML hypothesis exists
simulationAssumptions.justification: Synthetic per-node detection probability representing imperfect single-event behavioral alerting prior to cross-boundary correlation.
simulationAssumptions.reviewNote: Bounded in [0, 1]; held constant on the estate.

simulationAssumptions.applicableConditions: Estate-owned telemetry collection, incident decision, and response enforcement latency ranges
simulationAssumptions.justification: Models variation in automated and human-assisted SOC response pipelines across generated estates.
simulationAssumptions.reviewNote: Owned by the estate defensePosture; invariant when switching attacker profiles.
